claims.object_text: Transport of glucose from the bloodstream across the blood-brain barrier to the central nervous system is facilitated by glucose transport protein type 1 (GLUT1)
claims.quote: Transport of glucose from the bloodstream across the blood-brain barrier to the central nervous system is facilitated by glucose transport protein type 1 (GLUT1)

Heterozygous mutations in the GLUT1/SLC2A1 gene, occurring de novo or inherited as an autosomal dominant trait, result in cerebral energy failure and a clinical condition termed GLUT1-deficiency syndrome (GLUT1-DS).
